abort.unsupported_device: The Bluetooth advertisement does not contain a supported device identity.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Bluetooth connection was checked and saved.

error.device_not_registered: No device in this Tuya account could be verified against the Bluetooth device.
error.too_many_candidates: More than four eligible devices were found in this Tuya account, so Bluetooth verification was not attempted. Remove unused devices of this type from the account and try again.
error.bluetooth_probe_failed: Bluetooth communication failed before the cloud credentials could be verified. Move the device closer and try again.
error.cloud_refresh_failed: Could not refresh the Tuya cloud device list. Try again later.
error.probe_setup_failed: Could not prepare device verification. Try again later.
error.device_verification_expired: Device verification expired or was claimed by another setup. Please retry.
error.v4_verification_failed: Home Assistant could not connect to this device over Bluetooth. Check that it is added in the Smart Life app, close the app, move the device closer and try again.
error.v4_failed_unsupported_model: This device model is not supported yet, so its Bluetooth connection could not be checked.
error.v4_failed_credentials: The login details from the Tuya cloud cannot be used for this device.
error.v4_failed_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the device over Bluetooth. Move it closer to Home Assistant or a Bluetooth proxy, close the Smart Life app and try again.
error.v4_failed_no_reply: The device connected but did not reply. It may use a Bluetooth login this integration does not support yet.
error.v4_failed_missing_key: This device uses a newer Bluetooth login that needs an extra security key, and the Tuya cloud did not provide one.
error.v4_failed_not_added: The device says it is not added to a Smart Life account. Add it in the Smart Life app and try again.
error.v4_failed_unsupported_version: The device uses a Bluetooth protocol version this integration does not support yet.
error.v4_failed_login: The device did not accept the login details from the Tuya cloud.
error.v4_failed_no_data: The device accepted the login but did not send any readings.
error.bluetooth_scan_failed: The complete Bluetooth advertisement was not received. Move the device closer and try again.
error.identity_not_decoded: The identity in the Bluetooth advertisement could not be decoded.

progress.verify_device: Checking that Home Assistant can connect to the device over Bluetooth...

reconfigure.description: Check the Bluetooth connection to this Tuya BLE protocol v4 device again. The device disconnects briefly during the check. Keep it close to Home Assistant and close the Smart Life app first. Your entities and settings are kept.

user.description: Enter your Tuya User Code (found in Smart Life app: Me > Settings > Account and Security > User Code).

qr.description: Scan this QR code in your Tuya Smart or Smart Life app.

discovered_device.description: Set up the discovered device {name} ({address}). Submit to retry the Bluetooth scan.

unverified.title: Add the device anyway?
unverified.description: You can still add {name} ({address}), but it may show as unavailable. Select Submit to add it, or close this window to cancel. Once added, downloading its diagnostics helps add support for it.

device.description: Select Tuya BLE device to setup. Device must be registered in the cloud using the mobile application.

invalid_fan_speed.message: Unsupported cleaning mode {fan_speed}. Choose one of: {fan_speeds}.
